title: Bayesian data analysis and the evidence discipline; synthesis project
summary: Scientists' models of people's models: parameter inference, posterior prediction and model checking, Bayes factors and the Savage–Dickey method, Bayesian data analysis of cognitive models; what a fit does and does not show; the final modelling project.

preparation.description: Read the web book's Interlude - Bayesian data analysis (people's models of coins versus scientists' models of people; parameters and predictives; model selection; BDA of cognitive models). Reference-only.
Read the OCW projects page (final project guidelines and two example projects) and the syllabus statement of the final project or paper.
